name: Spot and Mark!
desc:
Welcome to Spot and Mark 🔍

👉 You or your opponent picks a object! 
❌ While one finds the object, the other marks their page with X's
🔄 Switch turns once the object has been found!
👑 Fill up your page before your Opponent to WIN!

Be quick in finding the object as well as marking the page!!

NEW UPDATE: Added some polish and bug fixes!

✨Like and favorite the game to show support!

llm.loop: one player picks an object on a seek-and-find sheet -> the other finds it while the first marks X's on their board -> switch turns -> first to fill the board wins -> earn cash for skins and chairs
llm.objectives: fill your board before your opponent by finding objects quickly
llm.progression: cash for cosmetic chairs and skins, win streaks
llm.instructions: pick an object, find the object, mark your page, fill it first to win
unique: seek-and-find picture book turned into a 1v1 bingo-style race
paid sabotage (blind opponent, clear opponent's board)
llm.thumbnails: two avatars at a table with a seek-and-find sheet; 'Can you find the apple?' puzzle shot
llm.complexity_notes: table scene, 2D seek-and-find sheets, turn logic and matchmaking
